name: Hotel Toshi Palace Restaurant
why_it_matters: Three-floor 14-room hotel opposite the State Transport Station with an in-house multi-cuisine restaurant (7am-9pm) and a rooftop bar that locals use — rare combination in Aalo. Default sit-down option for both visitors and West Siang residents.
insider_tip: Rooftop is the room to ask for — the State Transport Station crowd makes the ground floor noisy in the morning. Apong (rice beer) availability depends on the week; ask on entry.
signature_address: Opposite State Transport Station, Rime Market, Sipu Colony, Aalo, West Siang, Arunachal Pradesh 791001

name: Cafe Aalo
why_it_matters: Aalo's standalone cafe-format venue listed on TripAdvisor's Arunachal Pradesh restaurant page (rated 4.0). Small, independent — the rare option in West Siang HQ with a cafe menu rather than a hotel-attached multi-cuisine kitchen.
insider_tip: Verify hours on visit — small-town independent cafes in Arunachal often run owner-set timings rather than published ones. Cash preferred.
